sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def scan():
    a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    sq={}
    for r in range(8,50):
        for c in range(10,50):
            if a[r][c] in 'RbN': sq.setdefault(a[r][c],[]).append((r,c))
    out={}
    for k,v in sq.items():
        rs=[p[0] for p in v]; cs=[p[1] for p in v]; out[k]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    mrows=[r for r in range(64) if 'M' in a[r][10:17]]
    cable={}
    for r in range(10,44):
        cells=[c for c in range(16,48) if a[r][c] in 'wg']
        if cells: cable[r]=(min(cells),max(cells))
    return (mrows[0],mrows[-1]) if mrows else None, cable, out

print('start', scan())
action(['DOWN']); print('DOWN', scan())
action(['RIGHT']); print('RIGHT(tip22)', scan())
action(['UP']); print('UP', scan())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<parameter=code>
def scan():
    a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    sq={}
    for r in range(8,50):
        for c in range(10,50):
            if a[r][c] in 'RbN': sq.setdefault(a[r][c],[]).append((r,c))
    out={}
    for k,v in sq.items():
        rs=[p[0] for p in v]; cs=[p[1] for p in v]; out[k]=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    mrows=[r for r in range(64) if 'M' in a[r][10:17]]
    cable={}
    for r in range(10,44):
        cells=[c for c in range(16,48) if a[r][c] in 'wg']
        if cells: cable[r]=(min(cells),max(cells))
    return (mrows[0],mrows[-1]) if mrows else None, cable, out

print('start', scan())
action(['DOWN']); print('DOWN', scan())
action(['RIGHT']); print('RIGHT(tip22)', scan())
